g.text: TUESDAY, OCTOBER 20, 2026
VOL. 1 • PREVIEW
SANGAI EXPRESS
THE VOICE OF NAGALAND
NAGALAND / NORTHEAST / NATIONAL / WORLD / BUSINESS / SPORTS
TOP STORY / NORTHEAST
THREE KILLED AMID RENEWED
VIOLENCE IN MANIPUR
Fresh reports place civilian safety and regional peace under renewed scrutiny.
Illustrative editorial photograph • October 20, 2026
Reports of violence in Manipur have once again
placed the protection of communities at the centre of
public attention, with families seeking answers.
The developments are being closely followed across
the Northeast, where concerns about peace and access
remain significant for communities and families.
IN TODAY’S EDITION
• NH-202 compensation findings disputed
• Nagaland culture reaches Canadian film festival
• Dr. T. Ao Trophy celebrates district football
PRESENTATION EDITION — NOT AN OFFICIAL PRINT ISSUE
